name: quote-aware csv parser (hand-rolled scanner)
note: Deterministic plan used by `agit demo`. No model, no network: this file IS the planner.

steps.why: Orient myself in the workspace before touching anything.
Read the parser so the fix is based on what the code actually does, not what the name suggests.
Pin the bug with a failing test first, so the fix is provable rather than plausible.
Confirm the new test fails for the stated reason before changing any logic.

Replace the naive split with a single-pass scanner: a comma inside quotes is literal data, and a doubled quote is an escaped quote. Unquoted fields keep the old trimming so existing callers see no change.
Run the whole suite, not just the new test, to prove the old behaviour still holds.
Both the new and the old tests pass, so the task is done.

args.summary: parse_row now scans the line once, tracking quote state, so commas inside quoted fields stay in one field and "" is read as a literal quote. Added test_quoted.py with four cases (quoted comma, quote stripping, escaped quote, whole-document parse). Unquoted fields are still trimmed, so test_csvkit.py passes unchanged.
